label: sec:descent-mirror
html: Descending from the four-dimensional Prym variety of Bring's curve to the two-dimensional Jacobian of the hyperelliptic quotient \mathcal{X}_5 projects out two of the four colour-tube degrees of freedom. The following remark records the Euler-characteristic sign inversion (\chi = -1 on the punctured orbifold quotient) that governs the mirror-bundle orientation under this descent.
